payload.name: pc-transfer-10
payload.description: Pure-logic raw TTL classifier. Reads a raw candidate with inputs.get('ttl') and returns an advisory decision object only: absent key -> {kind:'missing',ttl:null}; explicit null -> {kind:'null',ttl:null}; exact integer in 6..15 -> {kind:'integer',ttl:original}; anything else -> {kind:'invalid',ttl:null}. No bool/float coercion, no defaults, no exceptions, no imports, no I/O, no host calls. Typed inputs are a target interface requiring runner support; this is an unapproved draft.
